message: Follow-up scoped review: azure_graph.flatten currently accepts outputs but never validates their expressions. An otherwise safe resource graph could contain an output using listKeys/reference/another unsupported ARM function, while the module docstring promises unknown functions block. Validate every executable expression-bearing surface, including outputs and any evaluated variables, or explicitly reject outputs unsupported by this first version. Add a real compiled negative (e.g. otherwise safe VM with a listKeys output) and a benign output variant if outputs are supported. Metadata is inert and can remain data. Keep the bounded provider validator; no generic engine or new privilege. This is root implementation feedback, not a gate verdict.
